questions.question: An AI gives a confident fact. What should your team do?
options: Ask it to repeat the claim
questions.why: A confident tone does not prove a fact is true.

questions.question: Which prompt gives the clearest goal?
options: Explain how rainbows form in 3 short steps for a beginner
questions.why: A clear task, audience, and limit help an AI respond usefully.

questions.question: Which detail should stay out of a public chat?
questions.why: Keep addresses and other personal details private.

questions.question: Why can an AI answer sound right and still be wrong?
options: It can generate likely text without checking every fact
questions.why: Fluent writing and verified facts are different things.

questions.question: What is a smart way to use AI for homework?
options: Use it to learn, then check the answer and do your own work
questions.why: AI can support learning, but people should review and understand the work.

questions.question: Which CSS property changes text color?
questions.why: The color property sets the foreground text color.

questions.question: What helps text stay readable on a bright yellow card?
questions.why: Strong foreground and background contrast makes text easier to read.

questions.question: Which rule makes a heading purple?
questions.why: A CSS rule has a selector, braces, and a property-value pair.

questions.question: Which CSS property adds space inside a card’s border?
questions.why: Padding creates space between the content and its border.

questions.question: How should a game show a correct answer?
options: Use color and a clear label or icon
questions.why: More than one cue helps everyone understand the result.

questions.question: A button does nothing. What is the best first step?
options: Reproduce the problem and check the error
questions.why: A repeatable problem and its error message provide useful clues.

questions.question: What does HTML mainly describe?
options: The structure and meaning of page content
questions.why: HTML marks up content such as headings, links, and paragraphs.

questions.question: What does this JavaScript do?  const points = 4; points += 1;
questions.why: The += 1 operation adds one to the current value.

questions.question: What appears after print(2 + 3) runs in Python?
questions.why: Python evaluates the addition and print displays the result.

questions.question: After fixing a bug, what should you do?
options: Try the same steps again and check nearby behavior
questions.why: Retesting checks that the fix works and did not break nearby features.
